data.one_liner: Algorithms and utilities for the Material Design 3 color system.
data.what_it_does: Provides low-level algorithms and utilities that power the Material Design 3 color system. It handles choosing theme colors from images and creating tones of colors in a new color space.
use_when: You need to generate Material Design 3 color schemes or dynamic colors from images.
You are building a custom color system or tooling that requires low-level M3 color utilities.
avoid_when: You just want standard high-level dynamic color support in a Flutter application, where `dynamic_color` is recommended instead.
You do not need Material Design 3 color calculations.
strengths: Official algorithms and utilities backing the Material Design 3 color system.
Supports choosing theme colors from images and calculating tonal palettes.
weaknesses: It is a low-level package, requiring higher-level wrappers for standard app adoption.
External code contributions are not accepted on the repository.
